## Summary

The revision-width mismatch should be fixed so running deployments retain the identifiers used by history and completion.

## Changes
The pull request adds running-deployment output with a shortened revision and an attempt number, plus tests for the status prefix and attempt labels.

## Important
- app/display.py:14 — correctness — Preserve the 12-character revision in running status — For revision `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`, `status` displays `0123456`, while history and completion display `0123456789ab`. The new seven-character slice contradicts the function’s stated identifier contract. — For revisions sharing seven leading characters, users cannot distinguish running deployments or consistently match their identifiers across status and history.
